testcase.name: lost POST response is reconciled by GET and never blindly resubmitted
profiles keep independent answers and an old async result cannot populate another profile
reconciliation preserves newer edits when earlier POST was already persisted
existing answers restore edit and unchanged normalized answers never post
single choices map exact dataset codes and category codes without minutes
forbidden and connection errors remain distinct from no previous response
explicit unavailable and omitted answers send null without fabricated selections on reload
opening empty form never preselects answers or creates revision
failed save preserves edits and retries only after confirming latest data
authorization errors have local messages and do not permit saving unloaded data
unloaded authentication failure permits local choices but never permits POST
age is read from profile and changing it requires an explicit save not opening a form
unpublished latest endpoint is not empty data and cannot trigger POST or lose edits
